changeLog.change: Extends prior ASA acceptance from one hosted setting to all Admin approval families. Existing ASA evidence remains historical and is not relabelled as comprehensive deployed coverage.

Retains stable EASYGAS_DOORSTEP_ENABLED=false. Protected QA deployment may exercise that disabled handler using labelled fixtures; this is recorded separately from stable-demo positive coverage. Found saved-draft note validation friction and a Finance-only manifest action.

Expanded live service tests found Admin cash-record permission/UI gap. Fix preserves approved amount, actual receipt reference, replay, branch, verification and technician-only physical work checks. Recreated the service test booking instead of rewriting a completed failed/settled fixture.

H40/H41 isolate Admin financial verification using labelled synthetic receipt preconditions because imported event replay increased the QA proposal tracking version. Driver report progression was rejected correctly and is not claimed passed; full driver fulfilment is outside this Admin approval audit. The fixture importer now reconstructs derived event versions on newly created fixtures.

Completed117 retained hosted checks with all resolved failures retained. Added Admin service cash recording, optional saved-request routine notes and Admin manifest discrepancy action. No DDL/permission change in this audit; disabled stable capability remains held. Operational metadata reconciliation proves original row hashes rather than treating new QA/rate-limit events as business changes.
